key.name: window-app-configs
key.description: JSON containing the list of WM_CLASS and their restoration settings.

key.name: window-app-states
key.description: JSON containing the last saved dimensions and positions for each WM_CLASS.

key.name: known-wm-classes
key.description: List of WM_CLASSes seen by the extension.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show an icon in the top bar for quick access to Deja Window settings and to enable/disable the extension.

key.name: window-global-defaults
key.default: '{ "enabled": false, "restore_size": false, "restore_pos": false, "restore_maximized": false, "restore_workspace": false, "switch_to_workspace": false, "restore_minimized": false, "restore_above": false, "restore_sticky": false, "avoid_overlap": true, "locked": false, "excluded_wm_classes": [] }'
key.description: JSON object of restore_* flags applied to any NORMAL window without its own per-app config, plus a wm_class exclude list.
